bullets.text: AirDrop Codes Enhance Security - **Apple** introduces a new verification feature for **AirDrop** in iOS 26.2.
Shazam Reveals Song Highlights - The new 'Popular Segments' feature shows which parts of songs captivate listeners.
Apple Glasses Rumored Features - Anticipation builds for **Apple's** upcoming smart glasses with innovative functionalities.
Affordable Tesla EVs Launch - **Tesla** unveils stripped-back versions of the Model Y and Model 3 to boost accessibility.
Nex Playground Dominates Sales - The **Nex Playground** console is outselling the Xbox this holiday season.
Unitree's Humanoid Robot Fights - **Unitree** showcases a humanoid robot demonstrating impressive combat skills.
AI Data Centers Impact Infrastructure - The boom in AI data centers may hinder progress on other infrastructure projects.
Posha Robot Chef Review - The **Posha** robot chef offers autonomous cooking for busy families at a premium price.
